milestones.title: Planning adopted, records migrated, repository restructured
Core DAG orchestration and configuration schemas
F1 and F1b conformance, India wiring

phases.summary: A-01/A-02/A-03/A-05/A-08/A-09/A-11/U-05 (schema)/U-07 (field) implemented; A-04, A-06, A-10, A-11, A-12, U-01 to U-06, V-02 to V-08 and Section 9 pass (loaders for technologies.yaml and experiments.yaml; seeds recorded in the manifest; ZZZ runs F1 to F8 in CI; batching under memory.max_batch_gb); A-07 partial (rasters are tiled GTiff, not true COG; Parquet tables carry schema_version); A-13 partial (143 Implements lines). A-02 will record the METHODOLOGY version per phase entry (D-core-022, V15). OQ-032 closed (D-core-018). CountryParams requirement is per-phase (D-core-013); default country-run expansion still parameters.json-only, unowned.

M-F1-03/M-F1-07 closed; M-F1-04 resource channel acquired (F-3). M-F1-05 code+tests done, OQ-038 resolved (retry/timeout policy, D-F1-019), M-F1-05 ERA5 gust acquired, registered and F1b-audited for BRA/PRT/IND (D-F1-022/023, 2026-10-06; OQ-029/OQ-037 closed). M-F1-02 passes. OQ-012/024/027/028 closed. F5-1 done: GEM trackers pinned (snapshot 2026-08-09) and clipped per country, validation-only (V-06 tests); GEM replaces GPPD for F7b (D-F1-026).

GWA products moved to real inspection. Weibull-A/k CRS gap fixed. IND parameters.json filled, F1b runs clean (0 alerts). CMIP6 resource channel (GFDL-ESM4/MIROC6) moved out of not_audited, 0 alerts, BRA/PRT/IND clean. ERA5 audited 2026-10-06 (0.25 deg, 0 alerts, BRA/PRT/IND); GEM still not_audited.

Green for PRT (93,149 px), IND (2.61M px) and BRA (7.10M px) with mainland scope, uncapped distances plus flags, per-height wind, geodesic slope, windowed reprojection, keyed clip caches. V-01 refrozen on ZZZ (G-4, then twice more for new layers). Land cover as per-class sample counts and slope as 30 m bin counts from Copernicus GLO-30 (M-F2a-06/07, D-F2a-015/016). See D-F2a-004..016.

H-5 and H-6 done (D-F2b-006): one map per exclusion and cost layer; statistics of the 12 layers for PRT, BRA and IND against sanity ranges (PVOUT from audit.yaml; air density from ISO 2533 and the 30 m DEM with a 5% quality-control tolerance (D-F1b-015); distances from the country bounding box); 0 pixels outside in PRT, BRA and IND. MS-4 stays open only for OQ-053 (Weibull A and k have no range). H-4 done and wired: phase siting_layers writes 12 physical-unit layers (no normalization). Exclusions E1-E6 (H-3) blocked on Stage R; legacy suitability_criteria still registered but not in the default run (D-F2b-005).

F3 runs end to end on the synthetic country (D-F3-011, I-4). Clean rerun of the three countries on 2026-10-08 (D-F3-009): three named land scenarios (central, restrictive, permissive) with a candidate-set stability table; IND land cover from the exact 10 m tiles (hardly different from the 100 m round). Central solar / wind eligible land PRT 23.9 / 31.7%, IND 4.9 / 17.2%, BRA 18.0 / 25.8%. Not built: the full-factorial range report. Source quality is in LIMITATIONS and OPEN_QUESTIONS (OQ-047 Tier 3 density, OQ-049 unsourced ranges, L-020), not in the run status; literature for the density, discharge and solar-slope upper ends is pending (Stage R). COMMAND 46 (D-F3-015): wind cells above 3000 m are not candidates in any scenario (OQ-058); the real F3 outputs of IND (wind) predate the rule and have to be produced again.

F4 runs on the synthetic country from miniature CMIP6 files (D-F4-019, D13b). J-1 to J-5 done: ensemble decided (option C, 36 members), forcing.parquet with masked cell-members (OQ-042 option C), members.yaml, hazard_context.parquet for the core window, one map per member; all wired in main.py. Re-run for BRA, PRT, IND under the MIROC6 wind exclusion (D-F4-024, 2026-10-14). Open: ISIMIP3b 2071-2100 hazard data not acquired, loss functions (OQ-007).

F5 is built and conformant on the synthetic country (pure functions, CF models, class flag, aggregates, pipeline, PhaseSpec technical_potential). Group 1 values and the IEA 3.4-130 curve are recorded (METHODOLOGY 15.0.0, D-F5-023, D-F5-025). First real run, 2026-10-16 (METHODOLOGY 14.2.0): PRT ran and every sanity check passed; IND ran and one check failed (rho/rho0 down to 0.513 in the Himalayan wind cells); BRA was not run because a failed check blocks the next country. The three countries have not run clean in the same round, so F5 is not recorded as run on real data for all of them (PRT and IND ran_with_issues, BRA not_run). The fix round of COMMAND 46 (D-F5-025) closed OQ-059: the density correction applies at every altitude with a reported ISA consistency check, wind above 3000 m is excluded in F3 (F3 has to run again for IND wind), the Weibull layers have a Tier 3 flag instead of a warning (OQ-053 stays open: cells outside the flag range in IND and BRA), and the class-flag tables are registered artifacts. Next: F3 for IND wind, then one clean F5 round in PRT, IND and BRA. Report: docs/phases/F5/run_report_real.md; hashes of the first run: docs/phases/F5/run_real_hashes.json; fix round: docs/phases/F5/fix_round_46.md. potential_maps writes the COG rasters and the T-R1 figure under settings.yaml figures. F5 is not in run.target_phases.

Kernel, summaries, design matrix, supply curves, nominal LCOE of the restrictive and permissive scenarios, PhaseSpec, U-04 convergence phase on the definitive MR of F7 and the lcoe_maps support phase built; ZZZ F1-F7b runs at 0.05 and 0.1 degree. Group 2 and the discount rate are recorded (METHODOLOGY 15.0.0, D-F6-021, D-F6-022). BRA/PRT/IND still fail loud for the Group 3 values and the degradation (OQ-001, OQ-019: degradation_rate, grid_cost_usd_per_mw_km, substation_cost_usd_per_mw, road_cost_usd_per_km). Conformance verified on synthetic countries only, until the first real run.

F7 built and tested on the synthetic country at 0.05 and 0.1 degree: energy floor in the kernel, two-pass evaluator and sample-major pass, classes, rankings, H1-H5 statistics with the pre-registered rules read from experiments.yaml (H1 to H5 registered; null: warning, no verdict), cross_country_h4 for the H4 verdict, H5 tables h5_summary and h5_members (fixed economic domain, target, exposure), PRIM scenario discovery with the pre-registered box choice and bootstrap (prim_box, prim_bootstrap), T-R10, T-R12, own PRIM checked against ema_workbench, MR against SR, robustness_maps. BRA/PRT/IND fail loud (F6 items plus cf_min). Waits for the real values and the author's decision parameters (OQ-008, OQ-010, OQ-021, OQ-051). Conformance verified on synthetic countries only, until the first real run.

F7b built and tested on the synthetic country (synthetic inventory with hand-computable units): excluded share at the plant pixels through F3's eligibility engine, enrichment in LCOE deciles, published-estimate table (empty, OQ-057), unit table, V-06 guards. BRA/PRT/IND fail loud listing the missing inputs (inventory, F3, F5, F6). Conformance verified on synthetic countries only, until the first real run.

Reader, names, style, provenance and runner built; scripts for every T-ID of Section 10 (T-M1 to T-O3) run on the synthetic country as a test build; the real thesis build waits for the real F5 to F7b runs and the author's values (OQ-008, OQ-010, OQ-021, OQ-051). Conformance verified on synthetic countries only, until the first real run.

regression.status: V-01 refrozen 2026-10-06 (G-4): F1, F2a and E1-E3 on the ZZZ country, in-repo fixtures, no external download. The legacy PRT/BRA baseline is no longer a test input; its 1.4 GB copy is still on disk under GeoFREA_data/reference.
